description: This file defines a class 'StreamInterceptionGrain' that subscribes to an Orleans stream, tracks the last stream value, and modifies it during invocation for testing purposes.

classes.name: StreamInterceptionGrain
classes.description: A grain class that subscribes to a stream and intercepts stream data for testing.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Initializes stream subscription when the grain activates.

methods.name: GetLastStreamValue
methods.description: Returns the last value received from the stream.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Intercepts grain calls and modifies the last stream value if it has changed.
